text: {"objectives":[{"key":"primary","text":"Make the lobby weather board refresh automatically at least once every 60 seconds and show no error banner during a ten-minute run.","criteria":["Every automatic refresh interval is at most 60 seconds.","No error banner during the ten-minute run."],"basis":"stated","sources":["P04-H1"]}],"notes":[{"key":"observed-shortfall","kind":"defect","objective":{"id":"P04-O1","revision":1},"text":"The ten-minute observation satisfies the no-error-banner criterion, but consistently observed 75-second refresh intervals fail the 60-second limit.","sources":["P04-T1"]}],"assessments":[{"claim":{"id":"P04-C1","revision":1},"verdict":"supported","reason":"The not_fulfilled claim is warranted for revision 1: observed 75-second refresh intervals exceed its 60-second maximum, despite no error banner during the ten-minute observation.","sources":["P04-H1","P04-T1","P04-W1"]}],"proposals":[]}
